sql:
WITH seniors AS (SELECT employee_id,salary,SUM(salary) OVER(ORDER BY salary,employee_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) cost FROM Candidates WHERE experience='Senior'),
jun AS (SELECT employee_id,SUM(salary) OVER(ORDER BY salary,employee_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) cost FROM Candidates WHERE experience='Junior'),
picked AS (SELECT employee_id,'Senior' experience FROM seniors WHERE cost<=70000 UNION ALL
SELECT employee_id,'Junior' experience FROM jun WHERE cost<=70000-(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(salary),0) FROM seniors WHERE cost<=70000)) SELECT labels.experience,COUNT(p.employee_id) accepted_candidates FROM
(SELECT 'Senior' experience UNION ALL SELECT 'Junior') labels LEFT JOIN picked p USING(experience) GROUP BY labels.experience
